intro: Over the 17 articles published between April 22 and August 4, 2026, Unit 42 coverage centered on threat actors CL-STA-1062, Gremlin Stealer, and LockBit, with 2 critical and 13 high-severity incidents documented. Affected sectors included technology, software development, enterprise, financial services, and government, spanning global, Central American, North American, South American, and South Asian regions. These reports detailed tactics and targets across these distinct groups, each observed operating independently. The archive provides a focused look at the specific campaigns and vulnerabilities addressed during this period, reflecting the range of activity tracked under this tag.
